text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty P2 fired: PD#P98 — inference-tail-latency — embeddings-production-us-east-1 — threshold breach (p99 latency > 800ms). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/P98

pagerbot: Notifying rotation: @jen (primary oncall) -> pagerduty escalation chain triggered. Pages sent to 3 contacts.

jen (oncall): acked. I'm looking. Can someone paste the quick summary of customer impact?

kate (cust-succ): saw 2 customers with degraded embeddings upload (timeouts ~10s) — they reported via support ticket  #SUP-4921. CS notified. No major revenue impact confirmed yet, but ETA to restore important.

omar (SRE): I'm joining the thread. @jen can you confirm whether this is a spike or sustained? Any recent deploys to kv-cache?

jen (oncall): looks like a sharp onset ~174.6s ago according to metrics. No infra deploys in last 30m. There's a config change to cache eviction policy merged 2026-03-15T00:35 but that was 40m ago — could be related.

maria (infra): I see K/V cache nodes in us-east-1 with memory pressure -> OOM evictions started rotating between nodes. Autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough, load jumped. Node logs below:
```
[2026-03-15T01:02:11Z] kvcache-03 evict: reclaimed 1.2GB
[2026-03-15T01:02:12Z] kvcache-01 OOM-kill: process killed
[2026-03-15T01:02:13Z] kvcache-04 restart
[2026-03-15T01:03:05Z] evictions/sec 48 -> 120
```

jen (oncall): good catch. That aligns with p99 spikes. Action check: 1) scale kv-cache pool x2, 2) revert eviction-config toggle, 3) enable sticky-routing fallback to warm model variant. Who can run the scale now?

maria (infra): I'll run a temporary scale. `kubectl scale --replicas=6 deployment/kvcache-us-east` — doing it now. ETA ~90s for pods to be ready.

ops-watchdog-bot: autoscaler attempted scale at 1768654250 but throttled due to quota limit. Quota: 5 pools. Increase request sent to infra quota service.

omar (SRE): if quota blocked autoscaler that's the root cause. Good that infra is doing manual scale. Also recommend we flip config rollback now. Sanjay can you comment on eviction-config?

sanjay (eng-runtime): The eviction toggle (kv.eviction.policy=aggressive) was added to reduce memory blowups for large prefix caches but seems to introduce churn for short-lived heavy tails. Rolling it back to `moderate` should stabilize. I can deploy a rollback patch; small config change, 1-min rollout.

jen (oncall): go for rollback, @sanjay. Please post the command you run so we can track.

sanjay (eng-runtime): Rolling back now: `kubectl set env deployment/kv-cache KV_EVICT_POLICY=moderate --namespace=prod-us-east`

pagerbot: Change rolled out to 3/3 pods. healthchecks passing.

jen (oncall): maria, how's scale?

maria (infra): replicas at 6, 5/6 ready, startup logs show cache warmup. I also bumped pod memory by 1G on the new nodes.

jen (oncall): monitoring p99 — decreased to 420ms within 45s of rollback and scale. Still some errors in queue but trending down.

ops-watchdog-bot: error-rate for embeddings-production-us-east reduced from 4.5% -> 0.8% over the last 5 minutes.

kate (cust-succ): replied to the two affected customers advising mitigation in progress and ETA ~15m. They asked for postmortem when resolved.

omar (SRE): good. Any sign of correlated spikes in disk io or network on gpu shards? I checked serving nodes; they look healthy. Seems concentrated to kv-cache.

sanjay (eng-runtime): agree. The runtime hit K/V miss storms which cascaded into higher tokenization latency. Suggest we add short-term prefix cache bypass (config flag) to prevent repeated cache miss hotloops. I'll prepare a patch but hold for now; only if we see reoccurrence.

jen (oncall): status update in 10m. If stable for 20m we can close the PD. Omar, do you want takeover for next shift?

omar (SRE): can take ownership for the next 2 hours. I'll be in watch mode and will follow up on the quota request with infra.

maria (infra): quota increase request approved for autoscaler, pending provisioning (10-15m). I've also added a temporary runbook note: "manual scale if autoscaler throttled".

jen (oncall): thanks all — leaving the incident in Omar's hands. Handing off: jen -> omar. 

omar (SRE): acknowledged handoff. Current action items: 1) monitor p99 and errors, 2) confirm autoscaler quota propagation, 3) patch runtime bypass if recurrence. I'll post progress every 10m.

jen (oncall): closing my ack — feel free to ping if anything spikes again. :white_check_mark:

pagerbot: PD incident P98 status: acknowledged -> assigned to omar (SRE). Close criteria: p99 < 500ms AND error-rate < 1% for 20m.

omar (SRE): 10m check-in: p99 410ms, error-rate 0.6%. No new customer reports. Keeping open.

omar (SRE): 25m check-in: stable, autoscaler quota propagated, no further evictions. Filing postmortem stub: https://wiki.redwood/incedent-postmortems/P98-draft — will assign owners for root cause and follow-ups.

kate (cust-succ): customers updated with full timeline and ETA for postmortem. They requested notification when remediation complete.

omar (SRE): closing PD in 40m if metrics remain stable. Closing thread here, moving follow-ups to postmortem doc. Thanks team. :tada:
